source_query: sql recon 2026-08-19: SELECT ethnicity, COUNT(*) n, COUNTIF(hospital_expire_flag=1) deaths, AVG(hospital_expire_flag) mortality_rate FROM labmae.labpid_eicu.cohort GROUP BY ethnicity
decision_rule: Exclude Other/Unknown and blank ethnicity unconditionally (missingness, not an ethnicity category -- eicu_crd.patient.ethnicity has no separate NULL/UNKNOWN code, both show up as either the literal 'Other/Unknown' string or an empty string). Take the two largest remaining buckets subject to a minimum-size gate (n>=1000 and >=2% of cohort) as the binary contrast, mirroring config/race_bucket_map.json's MIMIC decision rule exactly. Unlike MIMIC's race field, eICU's ethnicity field is already coarse (7 categories total, no sub-bucket rollup needed) -- this file's race_map is an identity map plus the two exclusions, kept in the same shape as race_bucket_map.json for pipeline parity (eicu_channels.py's demographic_targets() reads it the same way mimic_channels.py reads race_bucket_map.json).
